description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Whipcorder, adding {W}.
When Whipcorder dies, Yedora triggers, returning Whipcorder from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Whipcorder by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Whipcorder's morph ability by paying {W}, turning it face up.
Repeat.
